name: Shirogane Kagura
source: The daughter of an old and strict Japanese family.  She is extremely self-disciplined and tends to take a neutral stance or that of a moderator in terms of the knighthood's internal conflicts.  She won the previous year's Festival and as a result gained the title of Weiss.  She wields a standard straight sword in combat, and her style is focused on countering her opponent's moves.  She hates lies and liars.
